Luganda: Batera okusikirizibwa essuubi ly’okufuna enjigiriza ennungi, embeera y’obulamu ennungi, awamu n’emikisa mingi egy’okufuna ensimbi.

Zulu: Ngokuvamile bashukunyiswa ithemba lemfundo engcono, izinga elingcono lokuphila, namathuba engeziwe okuthola imali.

Northern Sotho: Gantši ba hlohleletšwa ke dikgonagalo tša go hwetša thuto ye kaone, maemo a makaone a bophelo, le dibaka tše ntši tša go hwetša tšhelete.

Source: Researchers wanted to investigate the beliefs and attitudes of Nigerian youths who might be considering migrating.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayagala okunoonyereza ku ndowooza n’entwala z’abavubuka mu Nigeria abayinza okuba n’ekirowoozo ky’okuddukira mu mawanga amalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ ṣe ìwádìí lórí ìgbàgbọ́ àti ìhùwàsí àwọn ọ̀dọ́ oríléèdè Nàíjíríà tó lè fẹ́ kó lọ.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go nyakišiša ditumelo le maikutlo a bafsa ba ka Nigeria bao ba ka bego ba nyaka go hudugela dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ለመፍለስ ሊያስቡ የሚችሉ የናይጄሪያ ወጣቶችን እምነቶች እና አመለካከቶችን ለመመርመር ፈለጉ።

Source: They were especially interested in what they thought about entering or staying in a foreign country without going through the normal legal process.
Luganda: Okusinga ennyo baali baagala okumanya ebintu abantu abo bye baali balowooza ku kuyingira oba okubeera mu ggwanga eggwiira nga tebayise mu mitendera gy’amateeka egya bulijjo.
Yoruba: Ìfẹ́ wọn pàtó wà nínú ohùn tí wọ́n rò nípa wíwọ̀ tàbí dídúró ní orílẹ̀èdè àjèjì láì la ìlànà tó bófin mú kọjá.
Zulu: Babenesithakazelo ngokukhethekile kulokho ababekucabanga ngokungena noma ukuhlala kwelinye izwe ngaphandle kokuqhubeka nenqubo evamile yomthetho.
Hausa: Sun kasance suna sha'awar abin da suke tunani game da shiga ko zama a wata baƙuwar ƙasa ba tare da bin tsarin doka na yau da kullum ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba tloga ban a le kgahlego mabapi le seo ba bego ba nagana ge ba tsena nageng ye nngwe goba ba dula ka go yona gomme ba tsenela tshepedišo ye e tlwaelegilego ya semolao.
Amharic: በተለይም በመደበኛው የህግ ሂደት ውስጥ ሳያልፉ ወደ ውጭ ሀገር ስለመግባት ወይም ስለመቆየት የሚያስቡት ላይ ፍላጎት ነበራቸው።

Source: This practice, called irregular migration, is common, but not much research has been done on the experiences and motivations of individual people who are trying to migrate in this way.
Luganda: Enkola eno, eyitibwa okusenguka okumenya amateeka, yeeyoleka nnyo, naye okunoonyereza si kungi okukoleddwa ku bantu abagezaako okusenguka mu ngeri eno okwekuusa ku bintu bye bayitamu n’ebintu ebibasikiriza.
Yoruba: Ìṣe yìí, tí à ń pè ní ìṣípò tí ò bófin mu, wọ́pọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n wọn ò tí ì ṣe ọ̀pọ̀ iṣẹ́ ìwádìí lórí ìrírí àti ohun ìwúrí àwọn èèyàn tó ń gbìyànjú láti ṣí lọ ní ọ̀nà yìí.
Zulu: Lo mkhuba, obizwa ngokuthi ukufuduka okungajwayelekile, uvamile, kodwa alukho ucwaningo oluningi olwenziwe ngokuhlangenwe nakho kanye nokugqugquzela abantu ngabanye abazama ukufuduka ngale ndlela.
Hausa: Wannan al'ada, da ake kira ƙaura ba bisa ƙa'ida ba, abu ne da ya zama ruwan dare, amma ba a yi bincike da yawa ba a kan abubuwan da suka faru da kuma abubuwan da suke motsa ɗaiɗaikun mutane da suke ƙoƙarin yin ƙaura ta wannan hanyar.
Northern Sotho: Tshepedišo ye, ye e bitšwago bofaladi bjo bo sego molaong, e tlwaelegile, eupša ga se gwa dirwa dinyakišišo tše ntši mabapoi le maitemogelo le tlhohleletšo ya batho bao ba lekago go hudugela dinageng tše dingwe ka tsela ye.
Amharic: መደበኛ ያልሆነ ፍልሰት ተብሎ የሚጠራው፣ ይህ አሰራር፣ የተለመደ ቢሆንም፣ በዚህ መንገድ ለመፍለስ በሚሞክሩ ግለሰቦች ልምድ እና ተነሳሽነት ላይ ብዙ ጥናት አልተደረገም።

Source: Researchers also wanted to hear from people who had irregularly migrated from Nigeria, but then returned to their country.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baayagala okwogerako n’abantu abaali basenguse okuva mu Nigeria mu ngeri emenya amateeka naye oluvannyuma ne bamala ne bakomawo mu ggwanga lyabwe, bawulire kye bagamba.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tún fẹ́ gbọ́ láti ẹnu àwọn tó ti kúrò láti oríléèdè Nàíjíríà, tó sì padà sí orílẹ̀èdè wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bafuna nokuzwa ngabantu ababefuduke ngokungafanele besuka eNigeria, kodwa base bebuyela ezweni labo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma so jin ta bakin mutanen da suka yi ƙaura ba bisa ƙa'ida ba daga Nijeriya, amma suka komo ƙasarsu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši gape ba be ba nyaka go kwa go tšwa go batho bao ba ilego ba hudugela dinageng tše dingwe ka ntle le molao ba etšwa ka Nigeria, gomme go tloga fao ba boela nageng ya gabo bona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ከናይጄሪያ መደበኛ ባልሆነ መንገድ ከፈለሱ በኋላ፣ ግን ወደ አገራቸው ከተመለሱ ሰዎችም ጭምር መስማት ይፈልጋሉ።

Source: To learn about these experiences, they interviewed 70 young people in 4 Nigerian cities, including 7 who had already gone through irregular migration and then returned.
Luganda: Okusobola okumanya ebintu bino, baabuuza abavubuka 70 mu bibuga bya Nigeria 4, omwali abavubuka 7 abaali baasengukako mu ngeri emenya amateeka naye oluvannyuma ne badda.
Yoruba: Láti kọ́ nípa àwọn ìrírí wọ̀nyí, wọn fi ọ̀rọ̀ wá ọ̀dọ́ 70 lẹ́nu wò ní àwọn ìlú 4 ní oríléèdè Nàíjíríà, pẹ̀lú 7 tó ti lọ nípasẹ̀ ìṣípò tí ò bófin mu tó sì ti padà dé.
Zulu: Ukuze bafunde ngalokhu okuhlangenwe nakho, baxoxisana nentsha engu-70 emadolobheni angu-4 aseNigeria, kuhlanganise nabangu-7 kakade ababefuduke ngendlela engavamile base bebuya.
Hausa: Don sanin waɗannan abubuwan, masu binciken sun yi hira da matasa guda 70 a garuruwa 4 na Nijeriya, ciki har da 7 da suka yi ƙaura ba bisa ƙa'ida ba sannan suka dawo.
Northern Sotho: Go ithuta ka ga maitemogelo a, ba ile ba botšiša bafsa ba 70 dipotšišo ka ditoropokgolong tše 4 tša ka Nigeria, go akaretšwa ba 7 bao ba šetšego tsenetše bofaladi bjo bo sego molaong gomme ba boela morago ka nageng ya bona.
Amharic: እነዚህን ተሞክሮዎች ለማወቅ፣ በ4 የናይጄሪያ ከተሞች የሚኖሩ፤ 7 መደበኛ ባልሆነ ፍልሰት አልፈው ወደ አገራቸው የተመለሱትን ጨምሮ፣ 70 ወጣቶችን ቃለ መጠይቅ አደረጉ።

Source: The other 63 were youths who were considered “susceptible to migration” because they were unemployed, about to finish studying, or about to complete a year of compulsory national service.
Luganda: Bali abala 63 baali bavubuka abaatwalibwa okuba nga “balabika okuba nga bajja kusenguka” kubanga tebaalina mirimu, baali banaatera okumaliriza emisomo, oba nga banaatera okumalako omwaka ogwabwe omulamba omuntu gw’ateekeddwa okumala ng’aweereza eggwanga.
Yoruba: Àwọn 63 yòókù jẹ́ ọ̀dọ́ tí a kà kún pé wọ́n jẹ́ "afaragbà sí ìṣípò" torí wọ́n ò níṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́, fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ parí ètò ẹ̀kọ́ wọn, tàbí tí fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ parí isẹ́ ìsìn oríléèdè to jẹ́ dandan.

Hausa: Sauran 63 kuma matasa ne da aka yi la’akari da su “suna iya yin ƙaura” saboda ba su da aikin yi, sun kusa kammala karatu, ko kuma sun kusa kammala shekara ɗaya na hidimar ƙasa na tilas.
Northern Sotho: Bafsa ba bangwe ba 63 e be e le bafsa bao ba bego ba bonwa bjkalo ka bao ba ka bago le “kgahlego go bofaladi” ka gobane ba be ba hloka mešomo, ba be ba le kgauswi le go phetha dithuto tša bona, gob aba le kgauswi le go phetha tirelo ya bosetšhaba ya kgapeletšo ye e dirwago ngwaga o tee.
Amharic: የተቀሩት 63ቱ ወጣቶች ደግሞ ሥራ አጥ በመሆናቸው ምክንያት፣ ትምህርታቸውን ሊጨርሱ ሲሉ፣ ወይም የአንድ ዓመት የብሔራዊ ግዳጅ አገልግሎታቸውን ሊጨርሱ ሲሉ፣ “ለፍልሰት የተጋለጡ” የተባሉ ወጣቶች ናቸው።

Source: These young people were asked to complete a questionnaire and then placed into focus groups, where they were asked about their understanding of irregular migration and whether they themselves were interested in migrating.
Luganda: Abavubuka bano baasabibwa okujjuza olukalala l’'ebibuuzo n’oluvannyuma ne bateekebwa mu bibinja by’okukubaganya ebirowoozo, mwe baabuuzibwa ku kye bamanyi ku kusenguka okumenya amateeka awamu n’okubabuuza oba nga nabo bennyini baali baagala okusenguka bagende ewalala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní kí àwọn ọ̀dọ́ wọ̀nyí parí àtòjọ ìbéèrè ìwádìí wọ́n sì fi wọ́n sí ẹgbẹ́ alàfojúsùn, ní ibi tí wọn á tí bi wọ́n lórí ìmọ̀ won nípa ìṣípò tí ò bófin mú àti bóyá àwọn pàápàá nífẹ̀ẹ́ láti ṣípò.
Zulu: Laba bantu abasha bacelwa ukuba bagcwalise uhlu lwemibuzo bese befakwa emaqenjini okugxilwe kuwo, lapho bebuzwa khona ngokuqonda kwabo ukufuduka okungajwayelekile nokuthi bona ngokwabo babenentshisekelo yokufuduka.
Hausa: An buƙaci waɗannan matasan da su cika takardar tambayoyi sannan aka sanya su cikin rukunoni na keɓaɓɓun mutane, inda aka tambaye su game da fahimtarsu game da ƙaura ba bisa ƙa'ida ba da kuma ko su kansu suna da sha'awar yin ƙaura.
Northern Sotho: Bafsa ba ba ile ba kgopelwa go tlatša lenaneo la dipotšišo gomme ba bewa ka go dihlopha tša nepišo, fao ba ilego ba botšišw aka ga kwešišo ya bona ya bofaladi bjo bo sego molaong le ge eba bona ka bobona ba na le kgahlego go go huduga.
Amharic: እነዚህ ወጣቶች መጠይቁን እንዲያጠናቅቁ ተጠይቀው እና ወደ የትኩረት ቡድኖች ተመድበው፣ መደበኛ ያልሆነ ፍልሰትን በተመለከተ ያላቸውን ግንዛቤ እና ራሳቸው የመፍለስ ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው ተጠይቀዋል።

Source: In most cases, the young Nigerians knew about irregular migration.
Luganda: Mu mbeera ezisinga, abavubuka b’omu Nigeria bano baali bamanyi ebikwata ku kusenguka okumenya amateeka.
Yoruba: Ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà, àwọn ọ̀dọ́ Nàìjíríà ti mọ̀ nípa ìsípò tí ò ṣe déédé.
Zulu: Ezimweni eziningi, abantu abasha baseNigeria babazi ngokufuduka okungajwayelekile.
Hausa: A mafi yawan lokuta, matasan Nijeriya sun san ƙaura ba bisa ƙa'ida ba.
Northern Sotho: Mabakeng a mantši, bafsa ba ka Nigeria ba be ba tseba ka ga bofaladi bjo bo sego molaong.
Amharic: በአብዛኛዎቹ አጋጣሚዎች፣ ናይጄሪያውያን ወጣቶች ስለ መደበኛ ያልሆነ ፍልሰት ያውቁ ነበር።

Source: Researchers report that most of them knew someone who had travelled out of the country illegally, but many did not know the process for leaving the country legally.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti abasinga ku bo baali balina omuntu gwe bamanyi eyali yava mu ggwanga mu ngeri emenya amateeka, naye nga bangi baali tebamanyi mitendera giyitibwamu okusobola okuva mu ggwanga mu mateeka.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí jábọ̀ pé ọ̀pọ̀ nínú wọn mọ ẹnìkan tó ti jáde kúrò nínú orílẹ̀èdè ní ọ̀nà tí ò bófin mu, ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀pọ̀ ni ò mọ ìlànà tí à ń gbà kúrò nínú orílẹ̀èdè ní ọ̀nà tó bófin mu.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babika ukuthi iningi labo lazi umuntu ophume ngaphandle kwezwe ngokungemthetho, kodwa abaningi bebengayazi inqubo yokushiya izwe ngokusemthethweni.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce yawancinsu sun san wani da ya fita daga ƙasar ba bisa ƙa'ida ba, amma da yawa ba su san tsarin barin ƙasar bisa ƙa'ida ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bega gore bontši bja bona ba be ba tseba ka ga motho yo a ilego a hudugela nageng ye nngwe ka ntle le molao, eupša ba bantši ba be ba sa tsebe tshepedišo ya go tšwa ka nageng ka semolao.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች እንደሚሉት አብዛኞቹ በህገ ወጥ መንገድ ከሀገር የወጣን ሰው ያውቁ ነበር፣ ነገር ግን ብዙዎች በህጋዊ መንገድ ከሀገር የሚወጣበትን ሂደት አያውቁም ነበር።

Source: They also thought that irregular migration wasn’t really a crime, but rather a practical or smart option for improving their lives, because most migrants had a better standard of living in their new country.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baalowooza nti okusenguka okumenya amateeka tegwali musango, naye enkola ennungi gye basobola okukozesa okutumbula obulamu bwabwe, kubanga abantu abasinga abadduka mu ggwanga lyabwe baali mu bulamu bulungi mu ggwanga lyabwe eppya gye baagenda.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún rò pé ìṣípò tí ò bófin mu kì í ṣe ọ̀ràn, yálà ó jẹ́ ìṣe tàbí ìwọ̀fún tó jáfáfá láti mú ìgbé ayé wọn dára, torí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn tó ti ṣí lọ ń gbé ìgbé ayé tó dára ní orílẹ̀èdè tuntun tí wọ́n wà.
Zulu: Baphinde bacabanga ukuthi ukufuduka ngokungemthetho kwakungelona ngempela ubugebengu, kodwa kwakuyindlela engokoqobo noma ehlakaniphile yokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo, ngoba iningi labafuduki linezinga elingcono lokuphila ezweni labo elisha.
